items.excerpt: EDMONTON — Alberta Premier Danielle Smith's office is distancing itself from one of her party presidents who met in Calgary with U.S. Republican strategists looking to assist the province’s separation movement.

items.title: Cenovus Energy looks at oilsands growth as it signs $5.7B deal to buy Athabasca Oil
items.excerpt: CALGARY — Cenovus Energy Inc. is adding to its already hefty steam-driven oilsands holdings with a $5.7-billion cash-and-stock deal to buy Athabasca Oil Corp.
